prompt: clang-cl /Zp no value struct packing behavior
answer:
In `clang-cl`, `/Zp` with no value is treated as:

```text
-fpack-struct=1
```

Thus, it requests 1-byte maximum struct packing. The Clang driver tests explicitly show:

```text
/Zp   → -fpack-struct=1
/Zp2  → -fpack-struct=2
```

This differs from MSVC behavior in an important way: `clang-cl` implements `/ZpN` similarly to GCC/Clang’s `-fpack-struct=N`, which can also affect the alignment of the struct itself. MSVC’s `/ZpN` controls member placement and does not change the alignment of the struct itself. ([LLVM commit](https://lists.llvm.org/pipermail/cfe-commits/Week-of-Mon-20140721/111007.html), [LLVM bug](https://lists.llvm.org/pipermail/llvm-bugs/2020-April/082596.html))
